description: A painted interior of a wood-panelled room with a brick wall and a pedimented doorway. A man in a dark 18th-century suit with a white jabot and powdered wig raises his right hand and touches a book held by a man in a black robe with white bands. Seated and standing men in powdered wigs and period coats fill the room, and a tall man in a dark coat stands at the right. A wooden desk and papers are in the middle distance, and the frame is edge to edge with no text.
